name: __CredentialId__M365
label: M365 Credential
description: The M365 credential containing valid tenant ID, client ID, and client secret which is used to authenticate API requests.

name: FileUrl
label: File URL
description: The URL of the file in OneDrive or SharePoint.

name: Response
label: Response
description: Returns the Drive ID and Item ID of the specified file.

name: StatusCode
label: Status Code
description: Returns the HTTP status code from the M365 API after retrieving the Drive and Item ID.

name: Message
label: Message
description: Returns the HTTP status message from the M365 API after retrieving the Drive and Item ID.
